en.t: Still, a little impure attachment remains; what can be done?

units.source_text: 这答诗的一部分，想是侍女擅改的吧。

en.t: This part of the reply poem was probably altered by a lady-in-waiting on her own.

units.source_text: 源氏大将胸中无限悲伤，痛心之余，匆匆退出。

en.t: General Genji was filled with boundless sorrow, and in his heartbreak he hurriedly withdrew.
